instrument: Draft moratorium proposal, Raleigh City Council
summary: Draft moratorium set for an Oct 6, 2026 public hearing pauses acceptance, processing and approval of development applications and water and/or sewer extension and connection applications for data centers within the corporate limits and the extraterritorial jurisdiction, through no later than April 6, 2027. A "Minor Utility Data Center" (unmanned, combined building and land footprint of 10,000 sq ft or less, peak demand of 5 MW or less) is outside it; complete applications filed before the effective date keep permit choice.

source.citation: City of Raleigh, draft data center moratorium ordinance (posted for Oct 6, 2026)

notes: The only floor-area threshold identified in this corpus. Every other trigger in the file is expressed in megawatts, acreage, or gallons. Notes N.C.G.S. 160D-601(d) limits on down-zoning without owner consent. Correction: earlier reporting gave only the 10,000 sq ft half of the minor/major test.
confidence_note: Draft text read in the original; not yet adopted.
